import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import json
import re
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split, StratifiedKFold
from sklearn.preprocessing import LabelEncoder
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
from scipy.sparse import hstack, csr_matrix
import lightgbm as lgb
import warnings
warnings.filterwarnings('ignore')

# Load data
train = pd.read_csv('/data/dspredict-mledojo/stumbleupon/train.tsv', sep='\t')
test = pd.read_csv('/data/dspredict-mledojo/stumbleupon/test.tsv', sep='\t')

print(f"Train shape: {train.shape}")
print(f"Test shape: {test.shape}")
print(f"Train columns: {train.columns.tolist()}")
print(f"Label distribution:\n{train['label'].value_counts()}")

# Parse boilerplate JSON
def parse_boilerplate(bp):
    try:
        d = json.loads(bp)
        title = d.get('title', '') or ''
        body = d.get('body', '') or ''
        url_text = d.get('url', '') or ''
        return title, body, url_text
    except:
        return '', '', ''

train[['bp_title', 'bp_body', 'bp_url']] = pd.DataFrame(
    train['boilerplate'].apply(parse_boilerplate).tolist(), index=train.index
)
test[['bp_title', 'bp_body', 'bp_url']] = pd.DataFrame(
    test['boilerplate'].apply(parse_boilerplate).tolist(), index=test.index
)

# Combine text
train['text'] = train['bp_title'] + ' ' + train['bp_body']
test['text'] = test['bp_title'] + ' ' + test['bp_body']

# Numerical features
num_cols = [
    'alchemy_category_score', 'avglinksize', 'commonLinkRatio_1',
    'commonLinkRatio_2', 'commonLinkRatio_3', 'commonLinkRatio_4',
    'compression_ratio', 'embed_ratio', 'frameBased', 'frameTagRatio',
    'hasDomainLink', 'html_ratio', 'image_ratio', 'is_news',
    'lengthyLinkDomain', 'linkwordscore', 'news_front_page',
    'non_markup_alphanum_characters', 'numberOfLinks', 'numwords_in_url',
    'parametrizedLinkRatio', 'spelling_errors_ratio'
]

for col in num_cols:
    train[col] = pd.to_numeric(train[col].replace('?', np.nan), errors='coerce')
    test[col] = pd.to_numeric(test[col].replace('?', np.nan), errors='coerce')

# Fill NaN with median
for col in num_cols:
    median_val = train[col].median()
    train[col] = train[col].fillna(median_val)
    test[col] = test[col].fillna(median_val)

# Encode alchemy_category
le = LabelEncoder()
train['alchemy_category'] = train['alchemy_category'].fillna('unknown').replace('?', 'unknown')
test['alchemy_category'] = test['alchemy_category'].fillna('unknown').replace('?', 'unknown')
all_cats = pd.concat([train['alchemy_category'], test['alchemy_category']])
le.fit(all_cats)
train['alchemy_category_enc'] = le.transform(train['alchemy_category'])
test['alchemy_category_enc'] = le.transform(test['alchemy_category'])

# URL features
def url_features(url):
    if not isinstance(url, str):
        return 0, 0
    parts = url.split('/')
    depth = len(parts) - 3 if len(parts) > 3 else 0
    has_date = 1 if re.search(r'\d{4}', url) else 0
    return depth, has_date

train[['url_depth', 'url_has_date']] = pd.DataFrame(
    train['url'].apply(url_features).tolist(), index=train.index
)
test[['url_depth', 'url_has_date']] = pd.DataFrame(
    test['url'].apply(url_features).tolist(), index=test.index
)

feature_cols = num_cols + ['alchemy_category_enc', 'url_depth', 'url_has_date']

# TF-IDF on text
tfidf = TfidfVectorizer(max_features=5000, ngram_range=(1, 2), min_df=3, sublinear_tf=True)
all_text = pd.concat([train['text'], test['text']])
tfidf.fit(all_text)

train_tfidf = tfidf.transform(train['text'])
test_tfidf = tfidf.transform(test['text'])

# Combine features
X_num_train = csr_matrix(train[feature_cols].values)
X_num_test = csr_matrix(test[feature_cols].values)

X_train_full = hstack([X_num_train, train_tfidf])
X_test_full = hstack([X_num_test, test_tfidf])

y = train['label'].values

# Train/validation split
X_tr, X_val, y_tr, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_train_full, y, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=y
)

# LightGBM model
lgb_train = lgb.Dataset(X_tr, label=y_tr)
lgb_val = lgb.Dataset(X_val, label=y_val, reference=lgb_train)

params = {
    'objective': 'binary',
    'metric': 'auc',
    'learning_rate': 0.05,
    'num_leaves': 63,
    'max_depth': -1,
    'min_child_samples': 20,
    'feature_fraction': 0.8,
    'bagging_fraction': 0.8,
    'bagging_freq': 5,
    'reg_alpha': 0.1,
    'reg_lambda': 0.1,
    'verbose': -1,
    'n_jobs': -1
}

model = lgb.train(
    params,
    lgb_train,
    num_boost_round=1000,
    valid_sets=[lgb_val],
    callbacks=[lgb.early_stopping(50), lgb.log_evaluation(100)]
)

val_preds = model.predict(X_val)
val_auc = roc_auc_score(y_val, val_preds)
print(f"Validation Score: {val_auc:.6f}")

# Cross-validation
skf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=42)
cv_scores = []

for fold, (tr_idx, val_idx) in enumerate(skf.split(X_train_full, y)):
    X_tr_cv = X_train_full[tr_idx]
    X_val_cv = X_train_full[val_idx]
    y_tr_cv = y[tr_idx]
    y_val_cv = y[val_idx]
    
    lgb_tr = lgb.Dataset(X_tr_cv, label=y_tr_cv)
    lgb_v = lgb.Dataset(X_val_cv, label=y_val_cv, reference=lgb_tr)
    
    m = lgb.train(
        params,
        lgb_tr,
        num_boost_round=model.best_iteration,
        valid_sets=[lgb_v],
        callbacks=[lgb.log_evaluation(-1)]
    )
    
    preds = m.predict(X_val_cv)
    score = roc_auc_score(y_val_cv, preds)
    cv_scores.append(score)
    print(f"Fold {fold+1}: {score:.6f}")

print(f"CV Score (mean): {np.mean(cv_scores):.6f}")
print(f"CV Score (std): {np.std(cv_scores):.6f}")

# Train final model on all data
lgb_full = lgb.Dataset(X_train_full, label=y)
final_model = lgb.train(
    params,
    lgb_full,
    num_boost_round=model.best_iteration,
    callbacks=[lgb.log_evaluation(-1)]
)

# Generate predictions
test_preds = final_model.predict(X_test_full)

# Create submission
submission = pd.DataFrame({
    'urlid': test['urlid'],
    'label': test_preds
})

submission.to_csv('/submission/submission.csv', index=False)
print(f"\nSubmission saved. Shape: {submission.shape}")
print(submission.head())

    model.train()

    for imgs, labels in loader:

        optimizer.zero_grad()
        outputs = model(imgs)

        loss.backward()

        total_loss += loss.item() * len(labels)

np.random.shuffle(idx)
train_idx = idx[n_val:]
val_idx = idx[:n_val]

X_tr = X_train_imp[train_idx]
X_val = X_train_imp[val_idx]

# WMAE calculation
def wmae(y_true, y_pred, weights):
    return np.sum(weights * np.abs(y_true - y_pred)) / np.sum(weights)

# Best configuration from Step 9

for i, target in enumerate(intraday_targets):

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import StratifiedKFold
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
from sklearn.preprocessing import LabelEncoder
import lightgbm as lgb
import warnings
warnings.filterwarnings('ignore')

# Load data
train = pd.read_csv('/data/dspredict-mledojo/unimelb/unimelb_training.csv')
test = pd.read_csv('/data/dspredict-mledojo/unimelb/unimelb_test.csv')

print("Train shape:", train.shape)
print("Test shape:", test.shape)

# Separate target
y = train['Grant.Status'].values
train_id = train['Grant.Application.ID'].values
test_id = test['Grant.Application.ID'].values

# Combine for consistent preprocessing
train['is_train'] = 1
test['is_train'] = 0
test['Grant.Status'] = -1
combined = pd.concat([train, test], axis=0, ignore_index=True)

print("\nCombined shape:", combined.shape)

# ============================================================
# Feature Engineering
# ============================================================

# 1. Parse Start.date
combined['Start.date'] = pd.to_datetime(combined['Start.date'], dayfirst=True, errors='coerce')
combined['start_year'] = combined['Start.date'].dt.year
combined['start_month'] = combined['Start.date'].dt.month
combined['start_dayofweek'] = combined['Start.date'].dt.dayofweek

# 2. Contract Value Band - ordinal encoding
band_map = {'A':1,'B':2,'C':3,'D':4,'E':5,'F':6,'G':7,'H':8,'I':9,'J':10,'K':11,'L':12,'M':13,'N':14,'O':15,'P':16,'Q':17}
combined['contract_band_num'] = combined['Contract.Value.Band...see.note.A'].map(band_map).fillna(0)

# 3. Aggregate researcher features across 15 slots
num_researchers = 15
researcher_numeric_cols = [
    'No..of.Years.in.Uni.at.Time.of.Grant',
    'Number.of.Successful.Grant',
    'Number.of.Unsuccessful.Grant',
    'A..',  # A* publications
    'A',    # A publications
    'B',    # B publications
    'C',    # C publications
]

# Build aggregated features
agg_features = {}

for base_col in researcher_numeric_cols:
    vals = []
    for i in range(1, num_researchers + 1):
        col = f"{base_col}.{i}"
        if col in combined.columns:
            vals.append(combined[col].fillna(0))
    if vals:
        stacked = pd.concat(vals, axis=1)
        agg_features[f'{base_col}_sum'] = stacked.sum(axis=1)
        agg_features[f'{base_col}_max'] = stacked.max(axis=1)
        agg_features[f'{base_col}_mean'] = stacked.mean(axis=1)

# Count number of investigators (non-null Person.ID)
person_id_cols = [f'Person.ID.{i}' for i in range(1, num_researchers + 1) if f'Person.ID.{i}' in combined.columns]
person_stacked = combined[person_id_cols].notna()
agg_features['num_investigators'] = person_stacked.sum(axis=1)

# Count PHD holders
phd_cols = [f'With.PHD.{i}' for i in range(1, num_researchers + 1) if f'With.PHD.{i}' in combined.columns]
if phd_cols:
    phd_stacked = combined[phd_cols].apply(lambda x: x == 'Yes').astype(int)
    agg_features['num_phd'] = phd_stacked.sum(axis=1)

# Year of birth - use investigator 1 (primary)
combined['Year.of.Birth.1'] = pd.to_numeric(combined['Year.of.Birth.1'], errors='coerce')
agg_features['pi_birth_year'] = combined['Year.of.Birth.1'].fillna(combined['Year.of.Birth.1'].median())

# Role of investigator 1
combined['Role.1'] = combined['Role.1'].fillna('Unknown')

# Add aggregated features to combined
for feat_name, feat_vals in agg_features.items():
    combined[feat_name] = feat_vals.values

print("\nAggregated features created:", len(agg_features))

# 4. RFCD and SEO codes - use primary codes
rfcd_cols = [f'RFCD.Code.{i}' for i in range(1, 6)]
seo_cols = [f'SEO.Code.{i}' for i in range(1, 6)]

# Use first RFCD/SEO code as primary
combined['RFCD.Code.1'] = combined['RFCD.Code.1'].fillna(-1).astype(str)
combined['SEO.Code.1'] = combined['SEO.Code.1'].fillna(-1).astype(str)

# Count number of RFCD/SEO codes
rfcd_stacked = combined[rfcd_cols].notna()
combined['num_rfcd'] = rfcd_stacked.sum(axis=1)
seo_stacked = combined[seo_cols].notna()
combined['num_seo'] = seo_stacked.sum(axis=1)

# 5. Categorical encoding
cat_cols = ['Sponsor.Code', 'Grant.Category.Code', 'RFCD.Code.1', 'SEO.Code.1', 'Role.1']

for col in cat_cols:
    combined[col] = combined[col].fillna('Unknown').astype(str)
    le = LabelEncoder()
    combined[col + '_enc'] = le.fit_transform(combined[col])

# 6. Select final features
feature_cols = (
    ['start_year', 'start_month', 'start_dayofweek', 'contract_band_num',
     'num_investigators', 'num_phd', 'pi_birth_year', 'num_rfcd', 'num_seo']
    + [f'{c}_enc' for c in cat_cols]
    + list(agg_features.keys())
)

# Remove duplicates
feature_cols = list(dict.fromkeys(feature_cols))
print(f"\nTotal features: {len(feature_cols)}")

# Split back
train_df = combined[combined['is_train'] == 1].reset_index(drop=True)
test_df = combined[combined['is_train'] == 0].reset_index(drop=True)

X_train = train_df[feature_cols].values
X_test = test_df[feature_cols].values
y_train = train_df['Grant.Status'].values

print(f"\nX_train shape: {X_train.shape}")
print(f"X_test shape: {X_test.shape}")

# ============================================================
# LightGBM with 5-fold CV
# ============================================================
lgb_params = {
    'objective': 'binary',
    'metric': 'auc',
    'learning_rate': 0.05,
    'num_leaves': 63,
    'max_depth': -1,
    'min_child_samples': 20,
    'feature_fraction': 0.8,
    'bagging_fraction': 0.8,
    'bagging_freq': 5,
    'reg_alpha': 0.1,
    'reg_lambda': 0.1,
    'n_estimators': 500,
    'random_state': 42,
    'verbose': -1,
    'n_jobs': -1,
}

skf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=42)
oof_preds = np.zeros(len(X_train))
test_preds = np.zeros(len(X_test))
cv_scores = []

for fold, (train_idx, val_idx) in enumerate(skf.split(X_train, y_train)):
    X_tr, X_val = X_train[train_idx], X_train[val_idx]
    y_tr, y_val = y_train[train_idx], y_train[val_idx]
    
    model = lgb.LGBMClassifier(**lgb_params)
    model.fit(
        X_tr, y_tr,
        eval_set=[(X_val, y_val)],
        callbacks=[lgb.early_stopping(50, verbose=False), lgb.log_evaluation(period=-1)]
    )
    
    val_pred = model.predict_proba(X_val)[:, 1]
    oof_preds[val_idx] = val_pred
    
    fold_auc = roc_auc_score(y_val, val_pred)
    cv_scores.append(fold_auc)
    print(f"Fold {fold+1} AUC: {fold_auc:.6f}")
    
    test_preds += model.predict_proba(X_test)[:, 1] / 5

oof_auc = roc_auc_score(y_train, oof_preds)
print(f"\nOOF AUC: {oof_auc:.6f}")
print(f"CV Score (mean): {np.mean(cv_scores):.6f}")
print(f"CV Score (std): {np.std(cv_scores):.6f}")
print(f"Validation Score: {oof_auc:.6f}")

# ============================================================
# Save submission
# ============================================================
import os
os.makedirs('/submission', exist_ok=True)

submission = pd.DataFrame({

})
submission.to_csv('/submission/submission.csv', index=False)
print("\nSubmission saved!")
print(submission.head())
print(f"Submission shape: {submission.shape}")
print(f"Prediction range: [{test_preds.min():.4f}, {test_preds.max():.4f}]")

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import lightgbm as lgb
import warnings

DATA_DIR = '/data/dspredict-mledojo/walmart-recruiting-store-sales-forecasting'

train = pd.read_csv(f'{DATA_DIR}/train.csv')
test = pd.read_csv(f'{DATA_DIR}/test.csv')
stores = pd.read_csv(f'{DATA_DIR}/stores.csv')
features = pd.read_csv(f'{DATA_DIR}/features.csv')

# Parse dates
train['Date'] = pd.to_datetime(train['Date'])
test['Date'] = pd.to_datetime(test['Date'])
features['Date'] = pd.to_datetime(features['Date'])

# Merge stores info
train = train.merge(stores, on='Store', how='left')
test = test.merge(stores, on='Store', how='left')

# Merge features
feat_cols = ['Store', 'Date', 'Temperature', 'Fuel_Price', 
             'MarkDown1', 'MarkDown2', 'MarkDown3', 'MarkDown4', 'MarkDown5',
             'CPI', 'Unemployment']
train = train.merge(features[feat_cols], on=['Store', 'Date'], how='left')
test = test.merge(features[feat_cols], on=['Store', 'Date'], how='left')

# Fill markdown NAs with 0
for col in ['MarkDown1', 'MarkDown2', 'MarkDown3', 'MarkDown4', 'MarkDown5']:
    train[col] = train[col].fillna(0)
    test[col] = test[col].fillna(0)

# Fill CPI and Unemployment with forward fill per store
for df in [train, test]:
    df.sort_values(['Store', 'Date'], inplace=True)
    df['CPI'] = df.groupby('Store')['CPI'].transform(lambda x: x.fillna(method='ffill').fillna(method='bfill'))
    df['Unemployment'] = df.groupby('Store')['Unemployment'].transform(lambda x: x.fillna(method='ffill').fillna(method='bfill'))

# Date features
for df in [train, test]:
    df['Year'] = df['Date'].dt.year
    df['Month'] = df['Date'].dt.month
    df['WeekOfYear'] = df['Date'].dt.isocalendar().week.astype(int)
    df['DayOfYear'] = df['Date'].dt.dayofyear

# Encode store type
type_map = {'A': 0, 'B': 1, 'C': 2}
train['StoreType'] = train['Type'].map(type_map)
test['StoreType'] = test['Type'].map(type_map)

# Holiday weight
train['HolidayWeight'] = train['IsHoliday'].apply(lambda x: 5 if x else 1)

# Create lag features using the full training data

train_sorted = train.sort_values(['Store', 'Dept', 'Date']).reset_index(drop=True)

sales_lookup = train_sorted.set_index(['Store', 'Dept', 'Date'])['Weekly_Sales']

# For lag features, we need sales from 52 and 104 weeks ago
def add_lag_features(df, sales_lookup):
    df = df.copy()
    df['lag_52'] = np.nan
    df['lag_104'] = np.nan
    
    for idx, row in df.iterrows():
        store, dept, date = row['Store'], row['Dept'], row['Date']
        date_52 = date - pd.Timedelta(weeks=52)
        date_104 = date - pd.Timedelta(weeks=104)
        
        key_52 = (store, dept, date_52)
        key_104 = (store, dept, date_104)
        
        if key_52 in sales_lookup.index:
            df.at[idx, 'lag_52'] = sales_lookup[key_52]
        if key_104 in sales_lookup.index:
            df.at[idx, 'lag_104'] = sales_lookup[key_104]
    
    return df

# This loop approach is too slow - use merge instead
print("Creating lag features via merge...")

# Create lag dataframes
lag52_df = train_sorted[['Store', 'Dept', 'Date', 'Weekly_Sales']].copy()
lag52_df['Date_lag'] = lag52_df['Date'] + pd.Timedelta(weeks=52)
lag52_df = lag52_df.rename(columns={'Weekly_Sales': 'lag_52', 'Date': 'Date_orig'})
lag52_df = lag52_df[['Store', 'Dept', 'Date_lag', 'lag_52']].rename(columns={'Date_lag': 'Date'})

lag104_df = train_sorted[['Store', 'Dept', 'Date', 'Weekly_Sales']].copy()
lag104_df['Date_lag'] = lag104_df['Date'] + pd.Timedelta(weeks=104)
lag104_df = lag104_df.rename(columns={'Weekly_Sales': 'lag_104', 'Date': 'Date_orig'})
lag104_df = lag104_df[['Store', 'Dept', 'Date_lag', 'lag_104']].rename(columns={'Date_lag': 'Date'})

# Merge lags into train and test
train_sorted = train_sorted.merge(lag52_df, on=['Store', 'Dept', 'Date'], how='left')
train_sorted = train_sorted.merge(lag104_df, on=['Store', 'Dept', 'Date'], how='left')

test = test.merge(lag52_df, on=['Store', 'Dept', 'Date'], how='left')
test = test.merge(lag104_df, on=['Store', 'Dept', 'Date'], how='left')

print(f"Lag52 coverage in train: {train_sorted['lag_52'].notna().mean():.3f}")
print(f"Lag52 coverage in test: {test['lag_52'].notna().mean():.3f}")
print(f"Lag104 coverage in train: {train_sorted['lag_104'].notna().mean():.3f}")
print(f"Lag104 coverage in test: {test['lag_104'].notna().mean():.3f}")

# Historical average: mean sales per (Store, Dept, WeekOfYear)
hist_avg = train_sorted.groupby(['Store', 'Dept', 'WeekOfYear'])['Weekly_Sales'].mean().reset_index()
hist_avg.columns = ['Store', 'Dept', 'WeekOfYear', 'hist_avg_woy']

train_sorted = train_sorted.merge(hist_avg, on=['Store', 'Dept', 'WeekOfYear'], how='left')
test = test.merge(hist_avg, on=['Store', 'Dept', 'WeekOfYear'], how='left')

# Also add dept-level average
dept_avg = train_sorted.groupby(['Dept', 'WeekOfYear'])['Weekly_Sales'].mean().reset_index()
dept_avg.columns = ['Dept', 'WeekOfYear', 'dept_avg_woy']
train_sorted = train_sorted.merge(dept_avg, on=['Dept', 'WeekOfYear'], how='left')
test = test.merge(dept_avg, on=['Dept', 'WeekOfYear'], how='left')

print("\nFeature creation complete.")
print("Train shape:", train_sorted.shape)
print("Test shape:", test.shape)

import pandas as pd

from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score
import lightgbm as lgb
import re

# Load data
print("Loading data...")
train_df = pd.read_parquet('/data/dspredict-mledojo/wsdm-cup-multilingual-chatbot-arena/train.parquet')
test_df = pd.read_parquet('/data/dspredict-mledojo/wsdm-cup-multilingual-chatbot-arena/test.parquet')

print(f"Train shape: {train_df.shape}, Test shape: {test_df.shape}")

def extract_features(df):
    features = {}
    
    for col in ['prompt', 'response_a', 'response_b']:
        text = df[col].fillna('').astype(str)
        
        # Length features
        features[f'{col}_char_len'] = text.str.len()
        features[f'{col}_word_count'] = text.str.split().str.len()
        features[f'{col}_sentence_count'] = text.str.count(r'[.!?]+')
        features[f'{col}_line_count'] = text.str.count(r'\n')
        
        # Formatting features
        features[f'{col}_has_code'] = text.str.contains(r'```').astype(int)
        features[f'{col}_code_blocks'] = text.str.count(r'```')
        features[f'{col}_has_bullet'] = text.str.contains(r'^\s*[-*•]', regex=True).astype(int)
        features[f'{col}_bullet_count'] = text.str.count(r'^\s*[-*•]', re.MULTILINE)
        features[f'{col}_has_numbered'] = text.str.contains(r'^\s*\d+\.', regex=True).astype(int)
        features[f'{col}_numbered_count'] = text.str.count(r'^\s*\d+\.')
        features[f'{col}_has_header'] = text.str.contains(r'^#{1,6}\s', regex=True).astype(int)
        features[f'{col}_header_count'] = text.str.count(r'^#{1,6}\s')
        features[f'{col}_has_bold'] = text.str.contains(r'\*\*').astype(int)
        features[f'{col}_has_table'] = text.str.contains(r'\|.*\|').astype(int)
        
        # Content features
        features[f'{col}_avg_word_len'] = text.apply(
            lambda x: np.mean([len(w) for w in x.split()]) if x.split() else 0
        )
        features[f'{col}_unique_words'] = text.apply(
            lambda x: len(set(x.lower().split())) if x.split() else 0
        )
        features[f'{col}_has_url'] = text.str.contains(r'https?://').astype(int)
        features[f'{col}_question_marks'] = text.str.count(r'\?')
        features[f'{col}_exclamation'] = text.str.count(r'!')
        
    feat_df = pd.DataFrame(features)
    
    # Difference features (response_a vs response_b)
    feat_df['char_len_diff'] = feat_df['response_a_char_len'] - feat_df['response_b_char_len']
    feat_df['word_count_diff'] = feat_df['response_a_word_count'] - feat_df['response_b_word_count']
    feat_df['sentence_count_diff'] = feat_df['response_a_sentence_count'] - feat_df['response_b_sentence_count']
    feat_df['code_blocks_diff'] = feat_df['response_a_code_blocks'] - feat_df['response_b_code_blocks']
    feat_df['bullet_diff'] = feat_df['response_a_bullet_count'] - feat_df['response_b_bullet_count']
    feat_df['header_diff'] = feat_df['response_a_header_count'] - feat_df['response_b_header_count']
    feat_df['unique_words_diff'] = feat_df['response_a_unique_words'] - feat_df['response_b_unique_words']
    
    # Ratio features
    feat_df['char_len_ratio'] = feat_df['response_a_char_len'] / (feat_df['response_b_char_len'] + 1)
    feat_df['word_count_ratio'] = feat_df['response_a_word_count'] / (feat_df['response_b_word_count'] + 1)
    
    # Prompt-response overlap (simple word overlap)
    prompt_text = df['prompt'].fillna('').astype(str)
    resp_a_text = df['response_a'].fillna('').astype(str)
    resp_b_text = df['response_b'].fillna('').astype(str)
    
    def word_overlap(s1, s2):
        w1 = set(s1.lower().split())
        w2 = set(s2.lower().split())
        if not w1 or not w2:
            return 0.0
        return len(w1 & w2) / len(w1 | w2)
    
    feat_df['prompt_a_overlap'] = [word_overlap(p, r) for p, r in zip(prompt_text, resp_a_text)]
    feat_df['prompt_b_overlap'] = [word_overlap(p, r) for p, r in zip(prompt_text, resp_b_text)]
    feat_df['overlap_diff'] = feat_df['prompt_a_overlap'] - feat_df['prompt_b_overlap']
    
    # Response similarity
    feat_df['response_similarity'] = [word_overlap(a, b) for a, b in zip(resp_a_text, resp_b_text)]
    
    # Prompt length
    feat_df['prompt_char_len'] = prompt_text.str.len()
    feat_df['prompt_word_count'] = prompt_text.str.split().str.len()
    
    return feat_df
